svg.title: B1 observed SDK resource custody
svg.desc: Retained Sandbox, Workspace and Exec API intervals by logical actor. Diagnostic with tracing enabled and unknown cache. Exact agent lifetimes and child-process extent are unavailable.
svg.text: Rows group logical roles. Bars show retained resource/API intervals, including idle periods.
UTC ·15–16 October2026. SDK success boundaries are not kernel mount instants; Exec intervals do not establish child-process lifetime.
Exact active-agent lifetimes unavailable. Logical lanes can differ from actual Branch targets. Diagnostic; tracing enabled/cache unknown.
